answer: The anchor register is checked at draw time, thread lists the eligible set, and wander seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 40 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 40 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
